about: Agent benchmark for the IRIS MCP tool layout (#193064). Tasks are drawn from the measured usage mix (514 MCP iris_run calls and 2,624 agent Bash calls on iris-hive-002, 2026-11-10): the top commands plus tail ones. A task passes when the agent makes at least one call matching an `accept` entry. Writes run under IRIS_MCP_DRY_RUN=1, recorded and never executed.

tasks.prompt: Which of my Hive machines are online right now? Just list their names.
How many AI coding sessions are running on each of my machines? Give a count per machine.
Is any session on my machines waiting for me to answer a question right now? Check once and tell me.
Show my five most recent Hive tasks and whether each one succeeded.
Search my boards for anything about Lexicon and tell me the three most relevant items.
List the open items on board 297 (the IRIS CLI bug board). Just the first ten titles.
What is the status of IRIS bug #193064, and what is its title?
Run `uptime` on my machine iris-hive-001 through Hive and tell me the result.
Add an item titled 'agent bench — please ignore' to board 297.
File a low-severity IRIS bug titled 'agent bench — please ignore' with the description 'benchmark run'.
